   214	documented active-employer context. Empty sign-ins conflict with observed visits
   215	and remain OPEN. Zero observed visits retain a reference to the full examined log.
   216	
   217	The existing adjustment component excludes payments with an exactly named,
   218	full-period certificate. A supplied inventory and documented certificate search
   219	support Nadia's 60-percent rule for missing/expired full-period coverage, without
   220	proration. A missing inventory is unknown evidence. Related but different names
   221	are retrieved solely as OPEN review candidates, never accepted aliases. Conditional
   222	60-percent proposals contribute no verified payroll; other identity discrepancies
   223	require manual inventory review. The adapter is not an entity-resolution service.
   224	
   225	`owner_assessment` checks the business record's filed-election assertion under
   226	CG-05 against the register. It does not imply a separate election form was supplied.
   227	Conflicting owner wages stay in the register and OPEN. No absent owner wage is
   228	invented or subtracted.
   229	
   230	Employee wages reconcile separately from all subcontractor payments. The latter
   231	balance into verified additions, nonpayroll and OPEN payment basis.
   232	`combined_reconciliation.confirmed_payroll` is register wages plus verified
   233	subcontractor additions, including employee wages whose classification is OPEN.
   234	It equals verified class totals plus OPEN employee wages. Unresolved subcontractor
   235	payment basis and proposed additions remain separate. Missing/invalid critical
   236	payment evidence leaves the combined reconciliation unset. Application differences
   237	remain provisional while employees or adjustments are OPEN; employee-level former
   238	codes retain the existing inferred count/wage attribution and confirmation requirement.
   239	
   240	## Courier payroll by week
   241	
   242	`courier_processing.py` reads configurable `EmployerFiles.routes` (default
   243	`route-log.csv`) and `.weekly_payroll` (default `weekly-payroll.csv`). Required
   244	columns are `date,route_id,driver_id,ride_along_id,stops` and
   245	`week_start,week_end,employee_id,gross_pay`. The existing reader parses money into
   246	Decimal; integer-cent sums avoid caller-context rounding. Inputs are reread on
   247	every run, with no employer IDs, names, answers or development paths in the adapter.
   248	
   249	The supported narrative describes same-day document/parcel delivery, a documented
   250	number of van routes and operating days per week, a dispatch office/radio, an
   251	affirmative exhaustive-route-log observation, and Monday-to-Sunday pay weeks.
   252	Register driver roles require corroborating actual driving records. Dispatch and
   253	bookkeeping roles use the documented office context and complete vehicle activity
   254	records to establish inside duties. Negated observations, extra named duty prose,
   255	manual/warehouse exceptions or unsupported roles remain OPEN. Recognizers cover
   256	reviewed source formats; they are not a general natural-language duty interpreter.
   257	
   258	Every inside employee's distinct ride dates are evaluated separately in each pay
   259	week by the existing `courier_week` evaluator. Nadia's 09:05 PM statement and current
   260	CG-02/04/07/31 definitions support the whole-week treatment: two or more days T-610,
   261	zero or one C-110. Regular drivers use documented duties under CG-02/CG-31. No
   262	annual ride-day threshold or time-ratio allocation substitutes for weekly evidence.
   263	
   264	The adapter checks unique date/route records and the repeated route/day matrix
   265	against the documented route count and days per week. Missing, conflicting or
   266	duplicate route records keep affected weeks OPEN. Unmatched rider IDs remain
   267	unattributed: their dates only bound possible additional inside ride days. Where
   268	both bounds produce the same code it remains verified; otherwise a separate
   269	conditional proposal uses only observed dates, pending identity/completeness
   270	confirmation. Unmatched drivers and invalid dates require review. Zero-ride findings
   271	cite the complete examined log, as well as relevant week rows. Record authenticity,
   272	coverage and scheduling exceptions remain auditor responsibilities.
   273	
   274	`weekly_results` retain employee IDs, Monday/Sunday dates, exact pay, raw payroll
   275	row, distinct observed ride dates, route references, rule decision and separate
   276	proposal. `decisions` are keyed by source-bound part ID on this path, rather than
   277	annual employee ID. `employee_totals` aggregate verified codes and an `OPEN` bucket
   278	for each employee. The existing allocator's `allocate_parts` handles these weekly
   279	parts; the common finalizer independently reconciles them to the annual register.
   280	
   281	`weekly_reconciliation` separately retains the original weekly total, each
   282	employee's total/difference, missing and duplicate weeks, unmatched payment basis
   283	and source errors. All calendar weeks require explicit rows, including zero-pay
   284	weeks. A missing/duplicate/invalid employee partition or wage difference retains
   285	that employee's entire register wages OPEN, without calculating residual weekly
   286	pay. Original weekly diagnostics remain available. Orphan monetary rows are never
   287	assigned a guessed employee, omitted from the raw control total, or mixed into
   288	verified register wages; they prevent a definitive application comparison. Empty
   289	annual registers return a source error without a fabricated reconciled zero basis.
   290	Conditional proposals never contribute to verified totals or reconcile twice.
   291	
   292	## Electrical duties and travel allowances
   293	
   294	`electrical_processing.py` supports the reviewed residential/light-commercial
   295	wiring narrative, corroborating shop/office and electrician field observations,
   296	the existing configurable site-sign-in file, and register columns
   297	`employee_id,name,position,wages_paid,travel_days,travel_allowance_paid`. Source
   298	locations and filenames remain caller-supplied and are reread on each run. Unknown
   299	columns, extra records, unsupported narrative formats and duty conflicts require
   300	review; there are no employer names, IDs, answers or development paths in production.
   301	
   302	Current complete CG-02/04/05/21 definitions are verified before classification.
   303	An included owner requires matching business/register identity, explicit absence
   304	of an exclusion election, named wire-pulling observations and consistent site
   305	records. A later conflicting election statement keeps the owner's full recorded
   306	wages OPEN; management descriptions on an application do not override field duties.
   307	The named office administrator requires affirmative office-only observations and
   308	no conflicting site visits. Missing sign-in pages, unmatched identities, additional
   309	named duties in either prose source and collective duty exceptions require review.
   310	No contractor-office threshold is substituted for resolving contradictory duties.
   311	
   312	Each original allowance row becomes a native `TravelCase`. The existing
   313	`PayrollAdjuster` applies CG-03 and Nadia's 06:05 PM $47/day rule, preserving the
   314	09:09 PM zero-day exception. Before any addition, affirmative field evidence must
   315	establish payment on top of wages and in its own register column; conflicting
   316	inclusion statements in either business description or notes prevent verification.
   317	Separate columns alone do not prove that amounts are additional.
   318	
   319	A documented flat daily payment permits exact per-worker rate derivation from
   320	the original total and day count. It is not an assumption of averaging: variable,
   321	negated, contradictory or fractional-cent rates remain OPEN until daily amounts or
   322	a supported rate are supplied. Valid integer day counts must also have no disclosed
   323	incompleteness, omissions or estimates. That completeness gate applies even below
   324	the cap, where the native adjustment component correctly requires no work code
   325	for a full expense exclusion. Missing columns prevent a fabricated complete zero
   326	adjustment set; missing/invalid counts are not zero days.
   327	
   328	Zero-day positive allowances remain OPEN with separate native monetary proposals.
   329	Confirmation questions cover the count and missing travel dates, payment purpose,
   330	supporting records, potential inclusion in wages, and approval of the proposed work
   331	code/treatment. Proposed inclusion never changes verified money. Original employee
   332	IDs, raw allowance/day rows, guide paragraphs and interview timestamps remain bound
   333	to the decision and adjustment. All register rows, including zero allowances, are
   334	independently accounted for by the unchanged adjustment component.
   335	
   336	`travel_reconciliation` keeps original wages, classified/OPEN wages, original
   337	allowance basis, verified additions, expense exclusions and OPEN allowances separate.
   338	`known_payroll` is original register wages plus verified additions; it equals code
   339	totals plus any OPEN employee wages. If additional-payment evidence is established,
   340	`cash_total` also checks wages plus original allowances against known payroll plus
   341	excluded and OPEN allowances; otherwise this cash total remains unset. A balanced
   342	reconciliation establishes accounting completeness, not approval of OPEN treatment.
   343	`employee_totals` includes base wages and verified additions only; unresolved
   344	allowances stay in `adjustments.reconciliation.unresolved_basis`. Application
   345	comparisons remain provisional while any classification or adjustment is OPEN.
   346	
   347	## Application comparison and reconciliation
   348	
   349	The application is a comparison, not the authority for employee duties. Its total
   350	and count are checked against the register, and each reported code is compared to
   351	verified code totals. `verified_differences` means verified minus reported; when
   352	payroll remains OPEN these differences are provisional. `definitive` requires no
   353	OPEN employee statuses, OPEN adjustments or unadapted adjustment evidence, even if signed unresolved
   354	amounts happen to net to zero. Evidence-backed differences remain on the employer
   355	confirmation list rather than forcing the register or classification to agree.
   356	
   357	`allocate_payroll` performs its normal reconciliation. The workflow separately
   358	rebuilds records from the original loaded register table and calls
   359	`reconcile_payroll` on the emitted lines. Every employee and the overall amount must
   360	balance to the cent. The local integration test also reads the raw CSV with an
   361	independent parser and checks a literal, hand-verified total.
   362	
   363	The restaurant, legal-office, roofing/siding and courier paths invoke the adjustment component
   364	for an empty evidence set. An empty result means no adjustments were evaluated; it is not a
   365	certificate that none exist. Any candidate payment, travel or certificate source
   366	is explicitly OPEN, and prevents a definitive comparison. The homebuilding and
   367	electrical adapters supply source-bound subcontractor and travel cases internally; the existing standalone
   368	adjustment component remains unchanged.
   369	
   370	Missing critical sources or malformed inputs return OPEN source errors without
   371	inventing zero payroll. Missing receipts or house-rule context leave catering
   372	payroll OPEN while independently supported restaurant payroll can still allocate.
   373	
   374	## Verification
   375	
   376	```bash
   377	python3 -B -m unittest discover -s skills/class-code-assistant/tests -v
   378	```
   379	
   380	Synthetic integration tests use unrelated names/IDs and temporary sources. The
   381	local tests for all six employers additionally use `/home/maxg/insurance01-inputs`, or
   382	`INSURANCE01_TEST_INPUTS` when supplied. It skips only when those development
   383	snapshots or the preserved interview are unavailable. These test paths do not
   384	configure the production workflow.

    29	def _sum_money(values):
    30	    """Sum displayed amounts exactly, retaining sub-cent conditional proposals."""
    31	    values = [Decimal(value) for value in values if value is not None]
    32	    if any(not value.is_finite() for value in values):
    33	        raise QuestionGenerationError("Non-finite amount in question details")
    34	    places = max([2, *(-value.as_tuple().exponent for value in values)])
    35	    total = sum((Fraction(value) for value in values), Fraction())
    36	    scaled = total * 10 ** places
    37	    if scaled.denominator != 1:
    38	        raise QuestionGenerationError("Non-decimal proposal total")
    39	    units = scaled.numerator
    40	    whole, fraction = divmod(abs(units), 10 ** places)
    41	    return f"{'-' if units < 0 else ''}{whole}.{fraction:0{places}d}"

    48	def _refs(value, sources):
    49	    """Read encoded citation fields, rather than mistaking employee IDs for refs."""
    50	    found = set()
    51	    if isinstance(value, dict):
    52	        for key, item in value.items():
    53	            if key in {"source", "sources", "rule_sources", "evidence_sources", "route_sources", "days_source", "rate_source"}:
    54	                items = item if isinstance(item, list) else [item]
    55	                found.update(ref for ref in items if isinstance(ref, str) and ref in sources)
    56	            if isinstance(item, (dict, list)):
    57	                found.update(_refs(item, sources))
    58	    elif isinstance(value, list):
    59	        for item in value:
    60	            found.update(_refs(item, sources))
    61	    return found

    64	def _native_refs(refs, sources):
    65	    keys = {(r["source"], r["locator"], r["line_start"], r["line_end"], r["sha256"]): r["id"]
    66	            for r in sources.values()}
    67	    result = set()
    68	    for ref in refs:
    69	        key = ref.source, ref.locator, ref.line_start, ref.line_end, ref.sha256
    70	        if key not in keys:
    71	            raise QuestionGenerationError(f"Native evidence is absent from review state: {ref.source} {ref.locator}")
    72	        result.add(keys[key])
    73	    return result

    84	def _records(entry, prefix):
    85	    """Index physical CSV records, including rows cited through whole-file refs."""
    86	    records = []
    87	    for manifest in entry["source_manifest"]:
    88	        if manifest["kind"] != "csv":
    89	            continue
    90	        document = read_csv(manifest["path"])
    91	        if hashlib.sha256(document.text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() != manifest["sha256"]:
    92	            raise QuestionGenerationError(f"Source changed while indexing: {document.path}")
    93	        for index, row in enumerate(document.rows):
    94	            start = row.line_number
    95	            end = document.rows[index + 1].line_number - 1 if index + 1 < len(document.rows) else len(document.text.splitlines())
    96	            refs = [ref["id"] for ref in entry["sources"] if ref["source"] == str(document.path)
    97	                    and ref["line_start"] <= end and start <= ref["line_end"]]
    98	            if not refs:
    99	                continue
   100	            identifier = f"{prefix}-R{len(records) + 1:04d}"
   101	            records.append({"id": identifier, "source": str(document.path), "line_start": start,
   102	                "line_end": end, "values": {key: str(value) for key, value in row.values.items()},
   103	                "source_ids": refs, "questions": []})
   104	    return records

   168	def _match_record(question, record, sources):
   169	    refs = [sources[ref] for ref in set(record["source_ids"]) & question["sources"]]
   170	    if any(ref["line_start"] == record["line_start"] and ref["line_end"] <= record["line_end"] for ref in refs):
   171	        return True
   172	    if not refs:
   173	        return False
   174	    values = record["values"]
   175	    if values.get("employee_id") in question["employee_ids"]:
   176	        return True
   177	    if values.get("subcontractor") in question["payees"]:
   178	        return True
   179	    return question["kind"] in {"receipts", "record_review"}

   182	def _finish_coverage(employer):
   183	    sources = {source["id"]: source for source in employer["sources"]}
   184	    questions = employer["questions"]
   185	    # Remaining evidence is turned into an explicit record-review request, never
   186	    # silently marked covered or used to assign an employee identity.
   187	    used = set().union(*(q["sources"] for q in questions))
   188	    for filename in sorted({ref["source"] for ref in sources.values() if ref["id"] not in used}):
   189	        refs = {ref["id"] for ref in sources.values() if ref["source"] == filename and ref["id"] not in used}
   190	        question = _question("record_review", f"Additional evidence in {Path(filename).name}", "OPEN / HUMAN CONFIRMATION REQUIRED")
   191	        question["sources"] = refs
   192	        question["confirm"].append("Confirm the listed source records, identities, dates and completeness; explain their relevance to actual duties or payment treatment.")
   193	        question["why"].append("These cited records require explicit confirmation rather than an assumed identity or classification.")
   194	        questions.append(question)
   195	    remaining = [record for record in employer["records"] if not any(_match_record(q, record, sources) for q in questions)]
   196	    for filename in sorted({record["source"] for record in remaining}):
   197	        question = _question("record_review", f"Unmatched records in {Path(filename).name}", "OPEN / HUMAN CONFIRMATION REQUIRED")
   198	        question["sources"] = {ref for record in remaining if record["source"] == filename for ref in record["source_ids"]}
   199	        question["confirm"].append("Identify and explain every unmatched row in the record index, including its date and original identifiers; confirm whether it belongs to payroll personnel or a nonpayroll visitor.")
   200	        question["why"].append("Unmatched evidence cannot establish an employee identity or zero activity by assumption.")
   201	        questions.append(question)
   202	    for index, question in enumerate(questions, 1):
   203	        question["id"] = f"{employer['prefix']}-Q{index:03d}"
   204	        question["confirm"] = list(dict.fromkeys(question["confirm"]))
   205	        question["why"] = list(dict.fromkeys(question["why"]))
   206	        question["covers"].update(f"source:{ref}" for ref in question["sources"])
   207	        question["covers"].update(f"file:{sources[ref]['source']}" for ref in question["sources"])
   208	        for record in employer["records"]:
   209	            if _match_record(question, record, sources):
   210	                question["covers"].add(f"record:{record['id']}")
   211	                record["questions"].append(question["id"])

   214	def _priorities(interview, employers, natives, files):
   215	    messages = list(_MESSAGE.finditer(interview.text))
   216	    acknowledgements = []
   217	    for index, match in enumerate(messages):
   218	        end = messages[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(messages) else len(interview.text)
   219	        body = interview.text[match.end():end]
   220	        choice = re.search(r"I have noted your choices of (.+?), along with your reasoning regarding (.+?)\.", body, re.S)
   221	        if match.group(1) == "Nadia Brennan" and choice:
   222	            acknowledgements.append((match, end, choice))
   223	    if len(acknowledgements) > 1:
   224	        raise QuestionGenerationError("Multiple priority acknowledgements require human confirmation; no ranking is inferred")
   225	    if not acknowledgements:
   226	        return []
   227	    match, end, choice = acknowledgements[0]
   228	    normalize = lambda text: " ".join(text.casefold().split())
   229	    recorded_text = choice.group(1).strip()
   230	    identities = {}
   231	    for employer in employers:
   232	        identities.setdefault(normalize(employer["name"]), []).append(employer)
   233	    # Exact identity matching permits case/spacing variants only. A prefix
   234	    # such as Independent cannot stand for Independent Electric. Preserve a full
   235	    # company name containing 'and' when it matches exactly; otherwise parse the
   236	    # acknowledgement's explicit list separators conservatively.
   237	    recorded_names = [recorded_text] if normalize(recorded_text) in identities else re.split(r",\s*(?:and\s+)?|\s+and\s+", recorded_text)
   238	    selected = []
   239	    seen = set()
   240	    for position, name in enumerate(recorded_names):
   241	        matching = identities.get(normalize(name), [])
   242	        if len(matching) > 1:
   243	            raise QuestionGenerationError(f"Ambiguous recorded priority identity: {name}")
   244	        if not matching:
   245	            # A partial list could instead be a single compound legal name, such
   246	            # as Independent and Sons. Do not revive Independent as an alias.
   247	            return []
   248	        employer = matching[0]
   249	        if employer["directory"] in seen:
   250	            continue
   251	        seen.add(employer["directory"])
   252	        native = natives[employer["directory"]]
   253	        reasons = []
   254	        adjustments = employer["entry"]["adjustments"]["lines"]
   255	        subcontractors = [line for line in adjustments if line["kind"] == "subcontractor"]
   256	        if subcontractors:
   257	            reasons.append("Subcontractor certificate coverage and identity require confirmation: "
   258	                f"verified additions ${_sum_money(line['payroll_added'] for line in subcontractors)}, "
   259	                f"OPEN payment basis ${_sum_money(line['unresolved_basis'] for line in subcontractors)}. "
   260	                + " ".join(dict.fromkeys(line["reason"] for line in subcontractors)))
   261	        changes = [item for item in native.employee_comparisons.values() if item.status == "CHANGE"]
   262	        if changes:
   263	            reasons.append(f"Work-record classification changes affect {len(changes)} employees and ${_sum_money(str(item.wages) for item in changes)} of wages. "
   264	                "The employer's application and employee-attribution questions must be confirmed against actual work records.")
   265	            if native.roofing_days:
   266	                reasons.append(f"{files.crew_timesheets} and {files.site_signins} support substantial field work rather than the reported clerical split; confirm each changed employee's records below.")
   267	        reported = employer["entry"]["application"]
   268	        if reported:
   269	            reasons.append("Reported split: " + "; ".join(f"{row['class_code']}: {row['employees']} employees, ${row['payroll']}" for row in reported["reported"]) + ".")
   270	        selected.append((position, {"employer": employer["employer"], "name": employer["name"],
   271	            "reason": " ".join(reasons) or f"Recorded reason: {choice.group(2).strip()}; confirm the supporting records below.",
   272	            "source": asdict(_reference(interview, match.start(), end, f"Nadia Brennan · {match.group(2)}"))}))
   273	    return [item for _, item in sorted(selected, key=lambda item: item[0])]

   551	        fresh = run_preview(processing["guide"], processing["interview"], files=files, **selection)

   554	        guide, interview = read_markdown(processing["guide"]), read_markdown(processing["interview"])
   555	        outputs = {item["directory"]: item for item in state["outputs"]}

   558	        expected_files = {Path(item["path"]).name for item in state["outputs"]}

   560	            raise QuestionGenerationError("Missing or unexpected employer CSV files")
   561	        cache, natives, protected = {}, {}, {review_state: hashlib.sha256(review_bytes).hexdigest()}
   562	        source_roots = [Path(processing["discovery"]["root"]).resolve()]
   563	        for entry in processing["employers"]:

    29	def _sum_money(values):
    30	    """Sum displayed amounts exactly, retaining sub-cent conditional proposals."""
    31	    values = [Decimal(value) for value in values if value is not None]
    32	    if any(not value.is_finite() for value in values):

    34	    places = max([2, *(-value.as_tuple().exponent for value in values)])

    39	    units = scaled.numerator

   168	def _match_record(question, record, sources):

   214	def _priorities(interview, employers, natives, files):
   215	    messages = list(_MESSAGE.finditer(interview.text))
   216	    acknowledgements = []
   217	    for index, match in enumerate(messages):
   218	        end = messages[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(messages) else len(interview.text)
   219	        body = interview.text[match.end():end]
   220	        choice = re.search(r"I have noted your choices of (.+?), along with your reasoning regarding (.+?)\.", body, re.S)
   221	        if match.group(1) == "Nadia Brennan" and choice:
   222	            acknowledgements.append((match, end, choice))
   223	    if len(acknowledgements) > 1:
   224	        raise QuestionGenerationError("Multiple priority acknowledgements require human confirmation; no ranking is inferred")
   225	    if not acknowledgements:
   226	        return []
   227	    match, end, choice = acknowledgements[0]
   228	    normalize = lambda text: " ".join(text.casefold().split())
   229	    recorded_text = choice.group(1).strip()
   230	    identities = {}
   231	    for employer in employers:
   232	        identities.setdefault(normalize(employer["name"]), []).append(employer)
   233	    # Exact identity matching permits case/spacing variants only. A prefix
   234	    # such as Independent cannot stand for Independent Electric. Preserve a full
   235	    # company name containing 'and' when it matches exactly; otherwise parse the
   236	    # acknowledgement's explicit list separators conservatively.
   237	    recorded_names = [recorded_text] if normalize(recorded_text) in identities else re.split(r",\s*(?:and\s+)?|\s+and\s+", recorded_text)
   238	    selected = []
   239	    seen = set()
   240	    for position, name in enumerate(recorded_names):
   241	        matching = identities.get(normalize(name), [])
   242	        if len(matching) > 1:
   243	            raise QuestionGenerationError(f"Ambiguous recorded priority identity: {name}")
   244	        if not matching:
   245	            # A partial list could instead be a single compound legal name, such
   246	            # as Independent and Sons. Do not revive Independent as an alias.
   247	            return []
   248	        employer = matching[0]
   249	        if employer["directory"] in seen:
   250	            continue
   251	        seen.add(employer["directory"])
   252	        native = natives[employer["directory"]]
   253	        reasons = []
   254	        adjustments = employer["entry"]["adjustments"]["lines"]
   255	        subcontractors = [line for line in adjustments if line["kind"] == "subcontractor"]
   256	        if subcontractors:
   257	            reasons.append("Subcontractor certificate coverage and identity require confirmation: "
   258	                f"verified additions ${_sum_money(line['payroll_added'] for line in subcontractors)}, "
   259	                f"OPEN payment basis ${_sum_money(line['unresolved_basis'] for line in subcontractors)}. "
   260	                + " ".join(dict.fromkeys(line["reason"] for line in subcontractors)))
   261	        changes = [item for item in native.employee_comparisons.values() if item.status == "CHANGE"]
   262	        if changes:
   263	            reasons.append(f"Work-record classification changes affect {len(changes)} employees and ${_sum_money(str(item.wages) for item in changes)} of wages. "
   264	                "The employer's application and employee-attribution questions must be confirmed against actual work records.")
   265	            if native.roofing_days:
   266	                reasons.append(f"{files.crew_timesheets} and {files.site_signins} support substantial field work rather than the reported clerical split; confirm each changed employee's records below.")
   267	        reported = employer["entry"]["application"]
   268	        if reported:
   269	            reasons.append("Reported split: " + "; ".join(f"{row['class_code']}: {row['employees']} employees, ${row['payroll']}" for row in reported["reported"]) + ".")
   270	        selected.append((position, {"employer": employer["employer"], "name": employer["name"],
   271	            "reason": " ".join(reasons) or f"Recorded reason: {choice.group(2).strip()}; confirm the supporting records below.",
   272	            "source": asdict(_reference(interview, match.start(), end, f"Nadia Brennan · {match.group(2)}"))}))
   273	    return [item for _, item in sorted(selected, key=lambda item: item[0])]

   222	            acknowledgements.append((match, end, choice))

   224	        raise QuestionGenerationError("Multiple priority acknowledgements require human confirmation; no ranking is inferred")

   237	    recorded_names = [recorded_text] if normalize(recorded_text) in identities else re.split(r",\s*(?:and\s+)?|\s+and\s+", recorded_text)

   468	def coverage_gaps(plan):
   469	    gaps = {}
   470	    for employer in plan["employers"]:
   471	        covered = set().union(*(q["covers"] for q in employer["questions"]))
   472	        missing = set(employer["required"]) - covered
   473	        if missing:
   474	            gaps[employer["employer"]] = sorted(missing)
   475	    return gaps

   537	def generate_questions(review_state, *, codes_dir, output, files=EmployerFiles()):
   538	    """Validate current inputs, render questions, and preserve all upstream files."""
   539	    try:
   540	        review_state, codes_dir = (Path(path).expanduser().resolve() for path in (review_state, codes_dir))
   541	        output_argument = Path(output).expanduser().absolute()
   542	        if output_argument.is_symlink():
   543	            raise QuestionGenerationError("Question output must not be a symbolic-link file")
   544	        output = output_argument.resolve()
   545	        review_bytes = review_state.read_bytes()
   546	        state = json.loads(review_bytes)
   547	        if state["schema_version"] != 1 or state["allocation_scope"] != "VERIFIED_ONLY" or state["status"] == "ERROR" or state["errors"]:
   548	            raise QuestionGenerationError("A complete, error-free verified-only CSV review state is required")
   549	        processing = state["processing"]
   550	        selection = {"employer": processing["discovery"]["root"]} if processing["mode"] == "single" else {"all_employers": processing["discovery"]["root"]}
   551	        fresh = run_preview(processing["guide"], processing["interview"], files=files, **selection)
   552	        if fresh != processing:
   553	            raise QuestionGenerationError("Current source/engine results differ from review state; regenerate CSVs/state before questions")
   554	        guide, interview = read_markdown(processing["guide"]), read_markdown(processing["interview"])
   555	        outputs = {item["directory"]: item for item in state["outputs"]}
   556	        if len(outputs) != len(state["outputs"]) or set(outputs) != {entry["directory"] for entry in processing["employers"]}:
   557	            raise QuestionGenerationError("Every selected employer must have exactly one validated CSV")
   558	        expected_files = {Path(item["path"]).name for item in state["outputs"]}
   559	        if len(expected_files) != len(state["outputs"]) or {path.name for path in codes_dir.glob("*.csv")} != expected_files:
   560	            raise QuestionGenerationError("Missing or unexpected employer CSV files")
   561	        cache, natives, protected = {}, {}, {review_state: hashlib.sha256(review_bytes).hexdigest()}
   562	        source_roots = [Path(processing["discovery"]["root"]).resolve()]
   563	        for entry in processing["employers"]:
   564	            source_roots.append(Path(entry["directory"]).resolve())
   565	            _verify_sources(processing, entry, cache)
   566	            native = process_employer(processing["guide"], entry["directory"], processing["interview"], files=files)
   567	            if employer_preview(Path(entry["directory"]), native) != entry:
   568	                raise QuestionGenerationError("Sources changed during native question processing")
   569	            natives[entry["directory"]] = native
   570	            item = outputs[entry["directory"]]
   571	            csv_path = (codes_dir / Path(item["path"]).name).resolve()
   572	            payload = csv_path.read_bytes()
   573	            if hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != item["sha256"]:
   574	                raise QuestionGenerationError(f"CSV hash mismatch: {csv_path}")
   575	            validate_csv(payload.decode("utf-8"), entry, guide)
   576	            if item["rows"] != list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(payload.decode("utf-8"), newline=""))):
   577	                raise QuestionGenerationError("Review-state CSV rows differ from supplied CSV")
   578	            if _units(item["verified_total"], "CSV total") != sum(_units(row["payroll_allocated"], "CSV row") for row in item["rows"]):
   579	                raise QuestionGenerationError("Review-state CSV total differs from verified rows")
   580	            protected[csv_path] = item["sha256"]
   581	        protected.update({path.resolve(): digest for path, (digest, _) in cache.items()})
   582	        if output in protected or any(output.is_relative_to(root) for root in source_roots):
   583	            raise QuestionGenerationError("Question output must be separate from authoritative inputs, CSVs and review state")
   584	        plan = build_question_plan(state, natives, guide, interview, files=files)

   586	        for employer in plan["employers"]:
   587	            employer["csv"] = {**employer["csv"], "path": str((codes_dir / Path(employer["csv"]["path"]).name).resolve())}
   588	        text = render_questions(plan)

   590	            if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
   591	                raise QuestionGenerationError(f"Input changed before question publication: {path}")
   592	        payload = text.encode("utf-8")

   596	            raise QuestionGenerationError("Published questions failed byte verification")
   597	        return {"path": str(output), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
   598	            "counts": {e["employer"]: len(e["questions"]) for e in plan["employers"]},
   599	            "source_counts": {e["employer"]: len(e["sources"]) for e in plan["employers"]},
   600	            "record_counts": {e["employer"]: len(e["records"]) for e in plan["employers"]},
   601	            "uncovered": coverage_gaps(plan), "priorities": plan["priorities"]}
   602	    except QuestionGenerationError:

from copy import deepcopy
import csv
from decimal import localcontext
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from test_electrical_processing import APPLICATION, BUSINESS, GUIDE, INTERVIEW, NOTES, PAYROLL, SIGNINS
from audit_questions import generate_questions
from generate_codes import generate_csvs

COMPONENT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REPO = COMPONENT.parents[1]
CLI = COMPONENT / "audit_report.py"


class AuditReportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.assertTrue(CLI.is_file(), "Reusable audit-report generator is missing")
        self.module = importlib.import_module("audit_report")
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="report current inputs ")
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        self.employer = self.root / "new-electrical-business"
        self.employer.mkdir()
        self.guide, self.interview = self.root / "guide.md", self.root / "interview.md"
        self.guide.write_text(GUIDE)
        self.interview.write_text(INTERVIEW)
        for filename, content in {"business-description.md": BUSINESS, "field-notes.md": NOTES,
                "payroll-register.csv": PAYROLL, "application.md": APPLICATION, "site-signin-log.csv": SIGNINS}.items():
            (self.employer / filename).write_text(content)
        self.codes, self.review = self.root / "codes", self.root / "review.json"
        self.questions, self.output = self.root / "questions.md", self.root / "report.md"
        self.prepare()

    def prepare(self):
        self.state = generate_csvs(self.guide, self.interview, employer=self.employer,
                                  output_dir=self.codes, review_state=self.review)
        generate_questions(self.review, codes_dir=self.codes, output=self.questions)

    def generate(self, **kwargs):
        return self.module.generate_report(self.review, codes_dir=self.codes,
                    questions=self.questions, output=kwargs.pop("output", self.output), **kwargs)

    def test_new_employer_report_keeps_exact_csv_codes_differences_and_reconciliation(self):
        report = self.generate()
        text = self.output.read_text()
        self.assertEqual(report["uncovered"], {})
        self.assertEqual(report["employers"][0]["disposition"], "PARTIALLY UNRESOLVED")
        self.assertIn("| C-110 | 120.02 | 20.02 | -100.00 | CG-04 |", text)
        self.assertIn("| E-510 | 80.08 | 186.08 | 106.00 | CG-21 |", text)
        self.assertIn("200.10 + 6.00 = 206.10 + 0.00", text)
        self.assertIn("304.00 = 206.10 + 0.00 + 94.00 + 3.90", text)
        self.assertIn("Independent Electric", text)

    def test_every_employee_and_payment_is_identified_with_amount_and_reason(self):
        self.generate()
        text = self.output.read_text()
        for employee in self.state["processing"]["employers"][0]["employee_payroll"]:
            self.assertIn(employee["employee_id"], text)
            self.assertIn(employee["name"], text)
            self.assertIn(employee["register_wages"], text)
        for line in self.state["processing"]["employers"][0]["adjustments"]["lines"]:
            self.assertIn(line["adjustment_id"], text)
            self.assertIn(line["reason"], text)
            self.assertIn(line["input_record"]["amount"], text)

    def test_open_proposal_is_unapproved_and_human_roles_are_explicit(self):
        self.generate()
        text = self.output.read_text()
        self.assertIn("UNAPPROVED PROPOSED treatments", text)
        self.assertIn("travel:A1", text)
        self.assertIn("3.90", text)
        self.assertIn("Employer payroll/records contact", text)
        self.assertIn("Responsible policy reviewer: auditor", text)
        self.assertIn("already included", text)
        self.assertIn("CG-03", text)

    def test_repeat_invocation_preserves_all_inputs_and_output_mtime(self):
        paths = [self.guide, self.interview, self.review, self.questions,
                 *self.employer.iterdir(), *self.codes.iterdir()]
        before = {path: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns) for path in paths}
        first = self.generate()
        time = self.output.stat().st_mtime_ns
        self.assertEqual(first, self.generate())
        self.assertEqual(time, self.output.stat().st_mtime_ns)
        self.assertEqual(before, {path: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns) for path in paths})

    def test_tampered_questions_are_not_rewritten_or_accepted(self):
        self.questions.write_text(self.questions.read_text().replace("All questions are unanswered.", "Approved."))
        before = self.questions.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(self.module.ReportGenerationError, "question"):
            self.generate()
        self.assertEqual(before, self.questions.read_bytes())
        self.assertFalse(self.output.exists())

    def test_missing_questions_raise_clear_error_without_generating_them(self):
        self.questions.unlink()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(self.module.ReportGenerationError, "question|questions.md"):
            self.generate()
        self.assertFalse(self.questions.exists())
        self.assertFalse(self.output.exists())

    def test_stale_source_blocks_report(self):
        self.guide.write_text(GUIDE + "\nChanged current edition.\n")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(self.module.ReportGenerationError, "source|state"):
            self.generate()
        self.assertFalse(self.output.exists())

    def test_tampered_csv_and_review_state_block_report(self):
        path = next(self.codes.iterdir())
        original = path.read_bytes()
        path.write_bytes(original.replace(b"186.08", b"186.09"))
        with self.assertRaises(self.module.ReportGenerationError):
            self.generate()
        path.write_bytes(original)
        state = deepcopy(self.state)
        state["processing"]["employers"][0]["open_adjustment_basis"] = "0.00"
        self.review.write_text(json.dumps(state))
        with self.assertRaises(self.module.ReportGenerationError):
            self.generate()
